chapter.verse: Note in nidang lai-inah leitung thu na zui uh a, van lama vangliatna a uk topa ahi nialna’ tate tungah tu-in zong na a sem kha’ deihna bangin, na mawhnate uh, na gitlohnate uh sungah si-in na om lai takun Pasian in note hong nungta sak hi.
Tua mite tawh eite khempeuh in zong nidang lai-in i ci-le-sa deihna ah lungsim deihna zui-in, si-le-sa deihna bangin gamta-in i om a, adang mite bangin ngeina bangin a hehna a thuak mi i hi hi.
Ahih hangin hehpihna tawh kidim Pasian in eite hong it phat maninah,
mawhna khialhna sungah si-a om eite Khazih tawh hong hing khawm sak zo hi. Note in hehpihna hang bekin gupna na ngah uh hi.
Khazih tawh eite hong tho sak a, vantung khua tawh kipawl omna-ah Khazih Zeisu tawh hong tu sak khawm hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Khazih Zeisu hangah eite hong hehpih a, a kicing mahmah ama hehpihna thupha a nung ciangin a kilatsak nading ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in thu-upna hangah hehpihna tawh gupna na ngah zo uh hi. Note ut thu-a ngah na hi kei uh hi: Pasian’ letsong ahi hi.
Kuamah in a kisaktheih loh nadingin note’ gamtat pha hangin gupna na ngah kei uh hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, eite in gamtat hoih i gamtat nadingin Khazih Zeisu sungah a pian’sak ama bawlsa i hi hi. Tua gamtatna pha eite in i gamtat nadingin Pasian in tua gamtatna a na siam khol zo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin khut tawh kibawl ci-le-sa sungah kibawl ‘vunat’ kici mite in vunat lo a cih uh, ci-le-sa pan Gentail mi ahi note in,
tua hun lai takin Khazih tawh kikhenin, Israel mi pawl hi loin, kiciamna a om thuciamna thute tawh kikum loin, lametna om loin, leitungah Pasian nei loin na om uh na ngaihsun ta un.
Ahih hangin nidang lai a, gamlapi-ah a om note in tu-in Khazih’ sisan hangin Khazih Zeisu kiang nai na tung zo uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua Khazih in eite gal kilemna hi a,

ngeina tawh kipawl Thukham kilemlohna thu a pumpi sungah a paihkhiat khit ciangin kikhen khia a, om kikal dalna kawm phelkhia-in, mi pawl nihte pawl khat bek a suak sak hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, gal kilem sakin ama sungah tua pawl nihte in pawl thak khat bek a suah nadingin bawl pha a, pawl khat bek suah khin a,
Khazih in singlamteh hangin kilemlohna thatin, tua mi pawl nihte pawl khat bek suak sakin Pasian tawh hong kilem sak nading ahi hi.
Amah hong kumsuk a, a gamla-in a om mite kiangah ahi zongin, a nai-in a om mite kiangah ahi zongin gal kilemna Lungdamna Thu a hilh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Khazih hangin ei pawl nihte in Kha Siangtho khat tawh Pa kiangah nai-in lut theih nading thu i ngah hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in tu-a kipanin mi pawl dangte ahi zongin, khual mite ahi zongin, na hi nawn kei uh a, Pasian’ mite tawh gammi khat na hi uh hi; Pasian’ innkuanpihte zong na hi uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, sawltakte-a kipan kamsangte ahi, khuam tungah note in zomin a kilam mi na hi uh hi. Khazih in tua innkiunuai suang ahi hi.
Tua suang leh inn khempeuh in kizomin khang a, Topa sungah a siangtho biakinnpi ahi hi.
Topa sungah note in zong Kha Siangtho hangin Pasian’ teenna na suah nadingun a kilam na hi uh hi.
